footer.description: TDOP connects talented individuals with exciting career opportunities. Your journey to success starts here.
footer.aboutText: The Tanzania Digital Opportunity Platform connects talented individuals with verified jobs, scholarships and training across the country.

about.pageSubtitle: TDOP is a trusted digital ecosystem connecting Tanzanians with verified opportunities — jobs, internships, scholarships, training, and tenders — from institutions you can trust.
about.missionBody:
To make opportunity discovery transparent, accessible, and trustworthy for every person in Tanzania. We believe that when people have clear, verified information about opportunities, they can make better decisions about their future.

TDOP exists to close the gap between opportunity seekers and legitimate opportunity providers by building a platform where every listing is traceable, every organization is identifiable, and every user is empowered.
about.visionBody: A Tanzania where no legitimate opportunity goes unnoticed — where every person, regardless of location or background, can discover, understand, and pursue opportunities that match their potential.
about.value1Desc: Every opportunity on TDOP is linked to an identifiable organization. Verification, transparency, and accountability are built into the platform.
about.value2Desc: We present opportunities with clear eligibility, requirements, deadlines, and application steps — no misleading claims, no hidden filters.
about.value3Desc: TDOP is built around the real journey of opportunity seekers — from discovery to application to outcome — not around advertising revenue.
about.value4Desc: TDOP is designed for Tanzania, available in English and Swahili, and built to serve people across all regions of the country.
about.step1Desc: Browse verified opportunities from trusted institutions. Filter by category, location, education level, and type.
about.step2Desc: Read clear eligibility criteria, requirements, benefits, and deadlines before you decide to apply.
about.step3Desc: Submit your application directly through TDOP with a cover letter and supporting documents.
about.step4Desc: Monitor your application status, receive notifications, and manage your opportunity journey from one dashboard.
about.impactSubtitle: Building Tanzania's most trusted opportunity platform
about.foundersDesc: The team behind TDOP — committed to transforming how Tanzania discovers and pursues opportunities.
about.founder1Bio: Former Director at the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology. 15+ years in public policy and digital transformation across East Africa.
about.founder2Bio: Full-stack engineer and systems architect. Previously built scalable platforms for fintech and edtech across Tanzania and Kenya.
about.founder3Bio: Operations specialist with deep experience in nonprofit management, stakeholder engagement, and cross-sector partnerships.
about.teamDesc: TDOP was created by a passionate team committed to serving the Tanzanian opportunity ecosystem.
about.partnersDesc: TDOP works with verified organizations across Tanzania to bring you legitimate opportunities.
about.partnersNote: Organizations listed are registered and verified on the TDOP platform.
about.milestone1Desc: Recognizing the gap between opportunity seekers and legitimate providers in Tanzania, the founding team set out to build a trusted platform.
about.milestone2Desc: Core platform developed with verification system, multi-role dashboards, and bilingual support for English and Swahili.
about.milestone3Desc: TDOP goes live with partner organizations, onboarding the first wave of institutions and opportunity seekers.
about.milestone4Desc: Expanding coverage across all 26 regions of Tanzania with enhanced recommendation engine and mobile experience.
about.ctaBody: Whether you are looking for your next opportunity or publishing one for others, TDOP is where trust meets opportunity.

help.pageSubtitle: Find answers, learn how to use TDOP, and get the support you need.
help.description: Find answers to common questions about using TDOP.
help.noResultsDesc: Try different keywords or browse by category.
help.contactDesc: Our team is here to help. Reach out and we will respond within 24 hours.
help.faq1Q: How do I create an account?
help.faq1A: Click Register on the navigation bar, fill in your details, choose your role (Seeker or Organization), and verify your email address. The process takes less than 2 minutes.
help.faq2Q: How do I get started after registering?
help.faq2A: After registering, complete your profile with your skills, education, and career goals. Then browse opportunities, save the ones you like, and start applying.
help.faq7Q: Do I need to verify my email?
help.faq7A: Yes. After registration, check your inbox for a verification link. Click it to activate your account. Check your spam folder if you don't see it.
help.faq3Q: How do I reset my password?
help.faq3A: Click Login, then click Forgot Password. Enter your email address and follow the link sent to your inbox to create a new password.
help.faq8Q: How do I update my profile information?
help.faq8A: Go to your Profile page from the dashboard, click Edit, and update your information including skills, experience, education, and career goals.
help.faq9Q: Can I change my account role?
help.faq9A: Contact support to request a role change. Your current data and applications will be preserved during the transition.
help.faq4Q: How do I search for opportunities?
help.faq4A: Use the Browse page to search by keyword, filter by category, location, education level, and type. You can also sort by newest, deadline, or popularity.
help.faq10Q: Can I save opportunities for later?
help.faq10A: Yes. Click the bookmark icon on any opportunity card to save it. View all saved opportunities from your dashboard under Saved.
help.faq11Q: What do the verified badges mean?
help.faq11A: A verified badge means the opportunity publisher has been reviewed and confirmed by TDOP. This helps you identify legitimate opportunities.
help.faq5Q: How do I apply for an opportunity?
help.faq5A: Open an opportunity, click Apply, write a cover letter, select relevant documents from your profile, and submit. You can track your application from the dashboard.
help.faq12A: Yes. Go to My Applications, open the application, and click Withdraw. You can withdraw applications that are still in Pending status.
help.faq13Q: How do I track my application status?
help.faq13A: Go to My Applications from your dashboard. Each application shows its current status: Pending, Under Review, Shortlisted, Accepted, or Rejected.
help.faq14A: Organizations register with the Organization role, complete their profile, and submit a verification request with supporting documents. Once verified, they can publish opportunities.
help.faq15A: Organizations submit a verification request with supporting documents. A TDOP verification officer reviews the request and approves or rejects it. Verified organizations get a trust badge.
help.faq6A: Yes. TDOP is free for seekers. Organizations can publish opportunities at no cost during the platform's early access period.
help.faq16Q: How do I report a suspicious opportunity?
help.faq16A: Open the opportunity and click the Report button. Choose a reason (scam, misleading, expired, etc.) and add details. Reports are reviewed by our trust team.
help.faq17A: Our verification team reviews organization registration documents, confirms their identity, and checks their legitimacy before granting verified status.

privacy.s1Body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, profile details, and documents you upload. We also collect usage data including pages visited, search queries, and interactions with opportunities.
privacy.s2Body: We use your information to provide and improve TDOP, match you with relevant opportunities, communicate with you about your account and applications, and ensure platform security and integrity.
privacy.s3Body: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your profile and application details with organizations you apply to. We may share data with service providers who help us operate the platform, and as required by law.
privacy.s4Body: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure. We encourage you to use strong passwords and keep your account credentials confidential.
privacy.s5Body: You can access, update, or delete your account information at any time from your profile settings. You may also request a copy of your data or ask us to restrict processing by contacting us.
privacy.s6Body: If you have questions about this privacy policy or how we handle your data, please contact us at info@tdop.go.tz.

terms.s1Body: By accessing or using TDOP, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.
terms.s2Body: TDOP is available to individuals aged 16 and above, and to organizations registered in Tanzania. You must provide accurate information during registration and keep your account secure.
terms.s3Body: You are responsible for the accuracy of your profile, applications, and published content. Organizations must ensure their opportunities are genuine, lawful, and accurately described. Misuse of the platform may result in account suspension.
terms.s4Body: TDOP does not guarantee employment, admission, or funding outcomes. Opportunities listed on the platform are published by third-party organizations. Always verify opportunity details directly with the publisher.
terms.s5Body: Content you upload remains yours. By uploading content to TDOP, you grant us a limited license to display and process it in connection with your use of the platform. TDOP branding and code are protected by intellectual property laws.
terms.s6Body: TDOP is provided as-is. We are not liable for damages arising from platform use, third-party opportunities, or service interruptions. We reserve the right to modify or discontinue the platform at any time.
